display.summary: Entry Clipboard, an opt-in snippet popover for entry forms, and stack schema stamps on generated stack files, reported by a new doctor check.
highlights: Entry Clipboard (Extra Features, off by default): copy, search and paste snippets between entry form fields, kept per user in the browser tab.
Generated stack files record the stack contract schema they were written for; the new stack.schema doctor check reports it.
The modal's Save and add another button keeps working without the loading-button helper.
